mapper.select: SELECT * FROM exam_paper ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_paper(name, duration_minutes, total_score, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES(#{name}, #{durationMinutes}, #{totalScore}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_paper SET name = #{name}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, total_score = #{totalScore}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE exam_paper SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
